scope: 13 active skill concepts, new character actions, separate VFX,13 active icons and Dịch Cân Kinh passive icon; presentation-only Phaser integration.
approvalEvidence: I explicitly waive concept and final-art approval gates for this task. Do not stop to request approval between stages.
referenceNotes: Actual Thieu Lam monk is in the lower half of artwork/thieu-lam-thien-son.png.
vo_dang_art_direction_reference.png is absent; vo_dang_character_reference.png is the actual inspected style reference.

artReadout: Approved monk: roughly2.5-head compact sturdy chibi, shaved head, readable wrapped fists/feet, ochre short robes/brown sash/beads, broad curved steel dao. Upper-left lighting, crisp selective pixel clusters, fixed elevated three-quarter orthographic camera; no new character design.
openQuestionTreatment: Bất Động Minh Vương follows currently documented healing artwork interpretation; mitigation question remains open. All VFX counts/cadence/radii are presentation proposals, not mechanics.
reusePolicy: Approved normal-attack clips remain byte-identical. New skill actions separately authored; shared stages/loops/cardinal VFX transforms explicitly listed. No mirrored weapon-hand character poses.

skills.action: Heavy closed-fist punch: low planted guard, chamber right fist, powerful short frontal punch, recover into protective guard. No open-palm spell.
skills.effect: Tight golden knuckle release, compact forward impact and a brief restrained guarding shimmer.
skills.icon: A single wrapped clenched fist in a compact angular gold guard.

skills.action: Deliberate armor-breaking fist strike: crossed guard, turn hip and chamber fist, short driving hammer-like punch, retract. Distinct from La Han's straight guard punch.
skills.effect: Short dense gold strike, sharp fracture impact, small broken-armor marker, fading shards.
skills.icon: A wrapped fist striking a split bronze breastplate.

skills.action: Heavy open-palm finisher: sink weight, draw open right palm to waist, thrust a large readable palm forward with planted legs, recover. Same monk, no giant replacement body.
skills.effect: Normal gold palm release and impact; separately stronger but readable empowered palm release and impact, target-specific presentation only.
skills.icon: A broad open golden palm with a bright compact diamond core.

skills.action: Spinning kick: guard/coil torso, turn on planted supporting foot and lift knee, extend sweeping spinning kick through facing direction, settle to guard. Clear wrapped feet and physically coherent hips.
skills.effect: Coiling gold windup, thin ground-plane elliptical spin arc, compact kick contact, diminishing arc.
skills.icon: One wrapped leg and cloth shoe turning inside a thin golden spiral.

skills.action: Low sweeping kick: lower center of mass, brace with bent supporting leg, extend the other leg into a broad ground-level sweep toward facing, recover upright. Do not replace this with a high roundhouse.
skills.effect: Low ochre preparation flecks, broad thin low golden crescent, contact dust/shards, fading ground trace.
skills.icon: A low extended wrapped foot sweeping a wide golden crescent.

skills.action: Rapid kick finisher: compact spring-loaded guard, one forceful front kick, alternate-leg follow-up with coherent hip transfer, recoil to guard. Feet deliberately airborne in kicks, unchanged ground anchor.
skills.effect: Normal short rapid gold foot traces and contact; separate empowered denser foot traces and contact. No global combo aura.
skills.icon: Three staggered wrapped-foot impressions progressing forward in gold.

skills.action: Defensive activation: planted guard, close crossed wrapped forearms at chest, brace with squared shoulders and fists, controlled return. No attack, meditation levitation or weapon.
skills.effect: Open golden protective ribs forming around body, restrained loop, brief hit response, clean dissolve. Center stays transparent enough to see monk.
skills.icon: Crossed wrapped forearms inside a compact segmented golden shield.

skills.action: Ground-strike ultimate: deep grounded preparation, raise striking fist/forearm while supporting hand guards, drive fist down into the ground with deliberate full-body commitment, recover from low stance. No giant Buddha replacing the character.
skills.effect: Compact gathered gold above ground, forceful golden ground impact with open-center fractured ring, restrained defensive aftereffect, ending sparks.
skills.icon: A descending wrapped fist striking a golden lotus-shaped ground fracture.

skills.action: Wide frontal melee dao slash: right-hand blade drawn back, broad horizontal cut into facing, follow-through with visible curved blade and left-hand guard, recovery. Blade stays attached to anatomical right hand.
skills.effect: Short metal-gold preparation glint, broad restrained gold melee slash, compact hit sparkle, small slowing ring marker. No traveling projectile.
skills.icon: The approved broad curved steel dao crossing a golden crescent.

skills.action: Ally protection field: stable dao guard, hold right-hand dao upright clear of head while left palm extends in a measured channel, brace stance, recover with blade visible. Do not drop or switch weapon.
skills.effect: Elliptical ground-plane defense field activation, open gold perimeter loop with small shield motifs, restrained outward defense pulse, ending. Not a healing spell.
skills.icon: A small golden shield at the center of an open protective ring.

skills.action: Powerful armor-breaking dao cut: deliberate high/diagonal preparation in right hand, heavy descending diagonal slash into facing, low strong follow-through, planted recovery. Clear broad blade distinct from Tru Ta horizontal cut.
skills.effect: Dense gold edge charge, forceful diagonal cut, localized fractured-armor contact, small armor-break marker.
skills.icon: A descending broad dao splitting a bronze armor plate with three gold fragments.

skills.action: Steady healing channel: dao held safely upright in anatomical right hand, left open palm close to chest then extends slightly, grounded controlled breathing, return. Strong practical monk identity.
skills.effect: Documented area-healing presentation: open gold lotus activation, soft outward healing pulse, restrained lotus perimeter loop, ending. Use healing interpretation only; do not settle open mitigation design question.
skills.icon: A small golden lotus with rising restorative light and an open palm.

skills.action: Wide golden-wave ultimate: grounded dao preparation, sweeping right-hand dao release into facing, extended broad follow-through with visible blade, measured recovery. No homing or spinning thrown weapon.
skills.effect: Layered leaf-shaped gold wave release, straight-traveling wide wave, compact directional impact, restrained separate allied-defense feedback. Keep center/character readable.
skills.icon: Layered golden leaf-shaped waves fanning forward above a small shield.
